historical_training_inventory.grouping_limitation: Image groups do not establish subject independence without subject IDs.
historical_training_inventory.historical_audit_caveat: Reserved from new fitting and selection; this audit pool was examined in earlier experiments and is not a pristine new confirmation set.

limitations: The training manifest covers 3136 retained annotation rows (1048 apo, 2088 fasc), not a newly enumerated complete competition directory. Unrepresented records are not audited.
Test hashes cover file bytes only; matching image pixels inside differently encoded or metadata-modified files will not be detected.
Training comparison reproduces the source grayscale+shape digest exactly. Public fingerprint JSON grayscale-only digests are not directly comparable because they omit shape.
No cropping, resizing, compression, intensity changes, near-duplicate, adjacent-frame or same-subject overlap exclusion is established by these exact hashes.
Public pretrained checkpoint training membership is not established by this user-project historical inventory.
Unknown subject identifiers prevent a claim of subject-independent validation.
